title: fix(plugin-list): date condition chips read as dates; showcase zh-CN region labels
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Fixes #37034

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 中文界面下，仪表盘钻取弹窗、所有列表的筛选条件（电脑端的条件标签和手机端的筛选面板）里的日期，从「≥ 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z」变为「≥ 2026年10月1日 00:00」这类本地日期；示例应用的发票「区域」、客户「销售区域」字段及其选项显示中文。
- 属于「仪表盘与报表」专项的验收发现，目的是让中文界面不再夹杂原始日期串和英文字段名。
- 若出错，只影响筛选条件上日期的显示文字，查询本身不变；可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

Sightings 1 and 2 of the card are fixed here. Sightings 3 and 4 are closed as by design under ruling record 7145739965 (the maintainer: 「同意」), and this PR does not touch them: the in-page edit state's filter bar shows the stored text, and a new widget's default 「New TYPE」 title is English author data (objectui#10678 / objectui#10651).

- **Date conditions read as dates (`@object-ui/plugin-list`).** `describeConditionValue` printed a date-family condition value with `String()`. It now formats the value with the new `formatConditionDate` (`conditions/conditionDates.ts`), on every condition row: the reader's chips, the view's locked chips, related-field view chips, and the phone filter sheet's rows. `formatConditionDate` is a thin selector over the console's one date display path, `formatDate` / `formatDateTime` from `@object-ui/core`; no second formatter is written. The locale comes from `useDisplayLocale()`, and `describeConditionValue`'s `locale` is now required, so no caller can fall back to the runtime's default locale by leaving it out.
  - A `date` field's bound is written on the wire as `YYYY-MM-DD` and shows that day with its year. An instant at UTC midnight on a date field shows the same calendar day in every zone.
  - A `datetime` field's bound is an ISO instant and shows the date and time in the display zone.
  - A `time` field, or a value the display path cannot read, is shown as written.
  - The filter sent to the server is unchanged.
- **The phone filter sheet (`phone/PhoneListPanels.tsx`).** Its condition rows now pass `useDisplayLocale()`. Before this, a zh-CN session on an English browser would have read 「Oct 1, 2026」 there.
- **The drilled month bucket.** The drill's condition writer (`plugin-dashboard` `drillConditions.ts`) already writes a bucket's `{ $gte, $lt }` as two rows, `greater_than_or_equal` and `before`. Both now read as dates: on the card's `created_at` they read 「创建时间：≥ 2026年10月1日 00:00」 and 「创建时间：早于 2026年11月1日 00:00」 (display zone UTC). The writer is unchanged, and a new test pins its two rows. No date-family operator means "on or after", and `after` (`>`) would drop the records at the bound, so the lower bound keeps `>=` (L1 accepted). A month bucket shows as its date range, not as 「2026-10」, because the row carries no granularity (ruling item 1).
- **Missing showcase translation.** `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts` zh-CN gains `fields.showcase_invoice.region` (区域, with option labels 美洲 / 欧洲、中东和非洲 / 亚太, matching the dashboard filter's own translation) and `fields.showcase_account.sales_region` (销售区域, same options). The drill chip already reads the translated field label. It does not read the dashboard filter's name (ruling item 2). `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` lowers app-showcase's ceiling from 449 to 441, a one-line hand edit with no `--update`.

## Tests

- `listConditions.test.tsx` gains a top-level `describe` for objectstack#37034. It mounts the real `ConditionChipRow` and `PhoneFilterSheet` under the real zh-CN `I18nProvider`, with the display zone pinned by `setDisplayTimeZone('UTC')`, and checks:
  - the sighting: a `created_at` datetime month bucket shows ≥ / 早于 chips reading 2026年10月1日 00:00 and 2026年11月1日 00:00;
  - a date field's `YYYY-MM-DD` bounds read as days;
  - a date field compared with a UTC-midnight instant reads as that day;
  - a datetime reads in the display zone;
  - a date `between` reads both ends as dates;
  - the phone sheet's row reads 「≥ 2026年10月1日」 while the runtime's own locale is English;
  - control: a `time` value and an unreadable date are shown as written.
- `drillConditions-36256.test.ts` pins the month bucket's two rows (operator and exact value).
- Ablation (one-off, source path; the test imports the module relatively, so no `dist/` is involved): readings are in the block below.

<details><summary>Ablations and readings at head a58282986 (worktree; overlap-check against origin/main 49c8e0f06 and PR 37059: clean)</summary>

- Formatter ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `ListConditionControls.tsx`): `(v: unknown) => formatConditionDate(v, field?.type, locale) : String` became `String : String`. Result: 6 failed and 1 passed (the control). The sighting case received exactly 「创建时间：≥ 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z」, the card's sighting. The other failures received 「开具日期：≥ 2026-10-01」, 「开具日期：≥ 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z」, 「开具日期：介于 2026-10-01 – 2026-10-31」 and, on the phone row, 「≥ 2026-10-01」. Restore: blob 50a651817635 after restore equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- Phone-row ablation (`PhoneListPanels.tsx`, the row's `locale` replaced with `undefined`): the phone case failed with 「≥ Oct 1, 2026」, the mixed-language row L1 predicted. Restore: blob 0b70cd730ed8 equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- In the previous round, a first formatter ablation used too narrow an anchor, which turned the selector into a function returning `String`. It was invalid and was discarded.
- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-list/ packages/plugin-dashboard/`: Test Files 404 passed (404), Tests 4167 passed and 6 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- type-check for `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:i18n`: exit 0. `pnpm check:i18n-coverage`: exit 0 ("OK (14 config(s), 577 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)"), with the app-showcase ceiling at 441.
- Derived gate list (66 commands): 65 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no full `pnpm build` here); CI runs it. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 derived, 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `playwright test --project=chromium --list`: exit 0, 202 tests in 35 files. No spec reads the changed text.
- Not run locally: `test:repo`, the full turbo suite and the browser check.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A naive `datetime-local` value (no offset, such as `2026-10-01T09:00`, which the advanced panel's datetime input writes) parses in the browser's zone but is shown in the display zone. When a host declares a display zone that differs from the browser's, such a chip can read a different hour than was typed. This is the existing behaviour of the shared date display path, not a change here.
- The drill writer keeps `>=` for a bucket's lower bound (see What changes).

## Verification

Two-minute check: in a zh-CN session, open the showcase's 营收概览（带筛选） dashboard and click a month bar on 「Invoices by Month」. The drill dialog's chips should read 「区域：欧洲、中东和非洲」-style (with a region picked) and 「开具日期：≥ 2026年…月1日」 / 「开具日期：早于 …」, with no ISO string. On a datetime field such as `created_at`, the chips show the date and time.

Read first: `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/conditionDates.ts` (the type-to-face rule, and the UTC-midnight day rule) and the `describeConditionValue` hunk in `ListConditionControls.tsx` (`locale` is now required).
